specific_diseases_listed: Critical Illness (28 days survival; pre-existing CI excluded)
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Length-of-stay choice 5/10/unlimited days. 60 listed Critical Illnesses include Cancer, MI, CABG, Heart Valve, Coma, Kidney Failure, Stroke, Major Organ Transplant, Paralysis, MND, MS, Brain Tumor, Blindness, Deafness, End-Stage Lung/Liver, Loss of Speech/Limbs, Head Trauma, Pulmonary Hypertension, Third Degree Burns, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Aorta Surgery, Diabetic Amputation, Myasthenia Gravis, Elephantiasis, Aplastic Anaemia, Addison's, Cardiomyopathy, Endocarditis, Ebola, Crohn's, Tuberculosis Meningitis, Encephalitis, SLE, Eisenmenger's etc.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured with opted number of days (5/10/unlimited)
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Telemedicine consultation covered per MCI guidelines.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured, more than 2 hours admission

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for inpatient AYUSH

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Per Women Care Benefit rider; 48 months waiting period

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Up to Base SI for newborn (Women Care)

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Up to Rs.3,000 per hospitalization (Emergency Road Ambulance)

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Lump sum INR 3,00,000 for 60 listed Critical Illnesses (optional rider)
critical_illness_cover.notes: Ages 18-45. 28-day survival. Once-in-lifetime per insured. Sum independent and over and above Base Cover.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Unlimited Refill (optional): 100% Base SI on first claim, all subsequent
restoration_benefit.notes: Anyone Illness Waiver - covers related + unrelated illnesses.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Stay Fit Health Check-Up Rs.5,000 once per Policy Year (18+ adults)

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Global Treatment (optional, Women Care): Planned In-patient outside India up to Base SI

notable_exclusions_summary: Health Edge is a highly modular indemnity+benefit policy covering 60 Critical Illnesses (with lump-sum payout), Modern Treatments, AYUSH, Booster Benefit (50% SI on claim-free renewal), and optional Women Care (Maternity, Newborn, Assisted Reproduction, Global Treatment). Length-of-stay choice (5/10/unlimited days) is unique.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network; reimbursement via document submission. 18001021111. CI claims require diagnostic confirmation per definition.
